{
  "name": "tagent",

  "description": "Tagent — terminal-native coding agent with a web GUI. Loop, subagents, skills, memory, plugins, MEGA + GitHub sync.",
  "type": "module",
  "bin": {
    "tagent": "./src/index.ts"
  },
  "main": "src/index.ts",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ai",
    "agent",
    "coding-agent",
    "cli",
    "gui",
    "tagent"
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/asysurya/tagent"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "start": "bun src/index.ts",
    "dev": "bun --hot src/index.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@tagent/core": "workspace:*",
    "cli-boxes": "^4.0.1",
    "figures": "^6.1.0",
    "picocolors": "^1.1.1",
    "socket.io": "^4.8.3",
    "string-width": "^8.2.2",
    "strip-ansi": "^7.2.0",
    "wrap-ansi": "^10.0.1"
  }
}
